items.title: fix(panel): restore trigger focus on Escape before hiding popover
items.implementation: Found by FAC-103 host run: execution-escape-restores-trigger failed on real Obsidian 1.13.7. In close(), move trigger.focus() before popover.hidden=true so focus leaves the popover before Blink can reset activeElement, and stopPropagation() the consumed Escape so the host's window-level Escape handling cannot steal the restored focus. Add a source-contract assertion in tests/ui/execution/contracts.test.ts pinning focus-before-hide ordering, matching the lane's existing style.

acceptance_criteria.description: Focused execution lane passes including the new ordering assertion
npm run check passes
Real host full probe passes all assertions after rebuild (execution-escape-restores-trigger included)

items.implementation: tests/host-matrix/planner-tooltip.mjs sleeps setTimeout(900) then asserts elapsedMilliseconds >= 900; Node timers may resolve ~1ms early, flooring to 899 under load. Wait 1000ms so the >= 900 setup invariant has headroom.

items.title: fix(factory): deliver must reject stale verification (contract or worktree drift)
items.implementation: Reproduced defect: verify->mutate acceptance command or tested source->deliver still exits 0. Stamp verified items with verified_head, verified_contract (sha256 of acceptance criteria + verify commands), and verified_work (sha256 of non-exempt worktree); deliver refuses when any drift is detected; backlog/.codex bookkeeping stays exempt.

items.implementation: Three bounded gaps: (a) stale-verification regression covered only the git fingerprint; add the no-git walk path variant. items.title: feat(factory): evidence.json records item_log_bytes so the log hash stays verifiable
items.implementation: The item JSONL is append-only; a post-delivery note or event extends it and a naive recompute of item_log_sha256 then mismatches. evidence.json now records item_log_bytes so a reviewer can verify sha256(log.slice(0, bytes)).
